## Leonardo da Brinci (G4)

Leonardo da Brinci is the elderly, Leonardo da Vinci-inspired unicorn painter who briefly sketches Spike and later joins a painting class with Tree Hugger in *My Little Pony: Friendship Is Magic*. Look for his pale olive-green coat, thick white eyebrows, flowing white beard and moustache, yellow eyes, black painter’s cap, light-yellow smock, and a cutie mark parodying the *Mona Lisa*. The green-bearded artist was [independently identified by viewers](https://scifi.stackexchange.com/questions/126062/who-is-the-green-bearded-painter-unicorn-in-s6-e4-on-your-marks) by matching his two appearances.

**Names and voice:** “Leonardo da Brinci” is a fandom/wiki *placeholder name*, not a confirmed spoken or credited name. The licensed Gameloft game lists him as **Unicorn Painter**, a [Canterlot character](https://mlp-gameloft.fandom.com/wiki/Characters/U_-_Z). An alleged internal name, “Neighonardo da Vinci,” is unverified. No spoken line or voice actor is reliably documented for this stallion.

**Appearances:** His identifiable scenes are *Princess Spike* (S5E10) and *On Your Marks* (S6E4); a picture from the latter also appears in the official short *Baby Flurry Heart’s Heartfelt Scrapbook*, episode 3, [“All About Alicorns”](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Baby_Flurry_Heart%27s_Heartfelt_Scrapbook). The pony *Mona Lisa* shown in comics or G5 imagery is the **subject of his cutie mark**, not an alternate identity or evidence that the painter himself appears in those works.

## Important moments

- **Spike’s portrait — “Princess Spike” (S5E10).** He paints Spike during the Canterlot summit, establishing the Renaissance-artist visual joke and revealing his *Mona Lisa* cutie mark. [Full-episode upload](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kOmTWrbWLIc); scene timestamp unavailable.
- **Tree Hugger’s art class — “On Your Marks” (S6E4).** He reappears among the painters depicting Tree Hugger during Apple Bloom’s “Out On My Own” montage, confirming he is a recurring background character rather than a one-off gag. [Official full episode](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=O3PtyzwcsUE); scene timestamp unavailable.
